Rambus new entrant competitor design win 2026 RCD PMIC MRDIMM

findings.claim: 10-K 列示記憶體介面晶片主要對手為 Monolithic Power Systems、Montage、Renesas、Texas Instruments；矽 IP 對手為客戶自家設計團隊及 Cadence、Synopsys；許多對手規模較大。
findings.excerpt: In the memory interface chip market, we compete with international semiconductor companies, including but not limited to Monolithic Power Systems, Montage Technology, Renesas and Texas Instruments. In the Silicon IP market, Rambus competes with the in-house design teams at our potential customers, as well as with third-party IP suppliers, such as Cadence and Synopsys.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：部分客戶內部評估或開發主張無需向 Rambus 授權的技術；公司無法預測在 AI 等目標市場能取得或維持的市占。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: We believe some of the competition for our technologies may come from our prospective customers, some of which are internally evaluating and developing products based on technologies that they contend or may contend will not require a license from us.

competitive_share_entrants.note: 搜尋未找到具名新進入者拿下 2026 年 RCD／PMIC／MRDIMM 設計案的來源。Rambus 自稱 2025 年底 DDR5 RCD 市占約 mid-40%（2024 約 early 40s），為管理層自述、無獨立 2026 數據；另有第三方分析稱 Q1 2026 競爭對手在搶市占，方向有衝突。Montage 40–42% 之數字來自低可靠度聚合頁，未採用。

clues.claim: Rambus 管理層稱 2025 年底 DDR5 RCD 市占約 mid-40%，高於 2024 年 early 40s（管理層自述）。
clues.source: MarketBeat Rambus Q4 2025 earnings call highlights

clues.claim: 第三方分析稱 Rambus Q1 2026 產品營收成長約 15% 低於市場成長，Montage、Renesas 在搶市占。
clues.source: munich-startup insights: Rambus misses Q1 targets as rivals capture AI memory market share

clues.claim: Q2 2026 財報會：HBM 新設計案為與美國 hyperscaler 的 IP 機會，非產品晶片設計案；並推出 DDR5 9600 晶片組。
clues.source: MarketBeat Rambus Q2 2026 earnings call highlights
